**Done. PR #204 is ready; only CI on the final head is outstanding** (background watcher running, will report).

## What I found

The brief asked me to confirm or refute #184's cache-key hypothesis. **The shape is confirmed and bigger than reported; the mechanism is refuted.**

The instrument (`docs/testing/clear_surface_fmt.py`) splits each `Clear` surface-format capture into *pixels explained by a later quad repeating an earlier quad's bytes* and *residual*:

| capture | diff | alias | aliased | residual |
|---|---:|:--|---:|---:|
| `SFC_A8R8G8B8` | 81936 | `00000` | 81920 | 16 |
| `SFC_X1R5G5B5_Z1R5G5B5` | 49152 | `.....` | 0 | **49152** |
| `SCF_X1R5G5B5_O1R5G5B5` | 0 | `.....` | 0 | 0 |
| `SCF_R5G6B5` | 40920 | `00000` | 40920 | 0 |
| `SCF_X8R8G8B8_Z8R8G8B8` | 81840 | `00000` | 81840 | 0 |
| `SCF_X8R8G8B8_O8R8G8B8` | 81840 | `00000` | 81840 | 0 |
| `SCF_X1A7R8G8B8_Z1A7R8G8B8` | 81936 | `00000` | 81920 | 16 |
| `SCF_X1A7R8G8B8_O1A7R8G8B8` | 98208 | `00000` | 81840 | 16368 |

`00000` means quad 0 served six times. Stable across 13 device runs at 13 distinct refs over 6 days.

**The refutation is one row.** All eight cases point at `GetTextureMemoryForStage(0)` with a byte-identical texture stage, so all eight share one `TextureKey` — and `SCF_X1R5G5B5_O1R5G5B5` is pixel-exact on all six swatches. The key is shared by the failures *and* the successes, so the key was never the variable. A second row narrows it: `SCF_X8R8G8B8_{Z,O}` already get an unconditional fresh image on every bind and still fail, so the stale thing is the **source the refill reads**, not the cache entry — a different defect from GL's `da9e02a2`.

I also split `SFC_X1R5G5B5_Z1R5G5B5`'s 49,152 px **out** of #184 — it shows no duplication at all and belongs to #164. Worth striking before anyone registers a prediction on this issue.

## What I did not establish, and said so

Which source, and why `R5G6B5` duplicates while the 1555 pair does not despite both failing `surface_is_texture_source()`. The rule that fits all eight rows is two-term over eight rows — a curve fit, and I named it as one rather than claiming a call site. That would have been the third unverified guess, which the brief explicitly forbade.

The settling experiment needs a **desktop** xemu build (count the three exits of `pgraph_vk_bind_textures` per bind), not device time. This worktree has no desktop toolchain and `dispatch/builds` holds apks only — that is the one part of the brief I could not finish, and it is handed back on the issue with the exact instrumentation point.

One thing I'd flag: `x1a7_clear_bytes.py` defaults its goldens to `/tmp/goldens/results`, which does not exist on this host — they are at `~/goldens/results`. Mine inherits that default for consistency, but anyone running either without `--goldens` gets eight PROBLEM lines rather than a result.
